usageNotes: Call this before stopping or destroying a Ceph OSD, MON, or MDS to let Ceph heuristically verify the cluster can safely absorb the action without losing redundancy or quorum. Check the returned `safe` boolean and read `status` when it is false — Ceph populates that field with the specific reason (e.g. insufficient PGs, quorum at minimum). Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/`; the node must be reachable and Ceph must be running.

examples.summary: Check whether OSD.2 can be safely stopped before maintenance

tips: A `safe: false` result does not block you from proceeding — it is advisory only. Review the `status` message before overriding.
For OSD removals, also check PG health and replication factor; this endpoint checks Ceph's heuristic, not the full CRUSH map.
MON safety checks are especially important in small clusters (3-node): destroying a MON when one is already down will break quorum.
This endpoint is read-only and has no side effects; it is safe to call repeatedly during a maintenance window.
